changelog: Docs: use /path/to/some.csv as the file argument example.
summary: Inspect delimited tables (CSV/TSV) before any analysis: column names, encodings, delimiters, row counts, inferred types, and first/last rows. Use when the user asks to peek a CSV, list headers, show head/tail, preview schema, check dtypes, or before pandas work on .csv/.tsv/.tab files. Use when the user runs /csv-inspect. Do not use for Excel workbooks (.xlsx) or for writing statistical reports — inspect only, then stop or hand off.
